source_text: Anthropological analyses argue that condemning FGM overlooks its voluntary acceptance by some adult women in contexts like certain West African groups, framing eradication campaigns as cultural imperialism that erodes local agency and provokes resistance, as observed in Nigeria where relativist defenses have slowed compliance with 2015 federal laws.
